crossRefs.note: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is…
When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and…
They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.
I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary…
Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;
so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be…
Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by…
They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us, while he spoke to us along the way, and while he…
For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it…

translations.web: All the people went their way to eat, to drink, to send portions, and to celebrate, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.
translations.bsb: Then all the people began to eat and drink, to send out portions, and to rejoice greatly, because they understood the words that had been made known to them.
translations.kjv: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared
translations.asv: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.
